title: Developments Of Civil Services
definition: The evolution of the British administrative machinery in India from a commercial agency (EIC) to a professional, merit-based, and hierarchical bureaucratic apparatus designed to consolidate colonial rule.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the 'Steel Frame' of British India, the transition from patronage to meritocracy, and the administrative legacy influencing modern Indian governance.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Developments Of Civil Services.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
